|---|---|
| B01 Written at | Bangkok Immigration Office |
| B02 Date / Month / Year (B.E.) | 24 / November / 2569 |
| B03 Full name in block letters | GIVEN_P1 MIDDLE_P1 SURNAME_P1 |
| B04 Nationality | Indian |
| B05 Visa | Tick NON-IMM |
| B06 Entry date / Month / Year (B.E.) | 26 / August / 2569 |

| B09 Arrival card number | NEEDS-YOU |
| B10 Lane / Road | NEEDS-YOU |
| B11 Tambol | NEEDS-YOU |
| B12 Amphur | NEEDS-YOU |
| B13 Province | Bangkok |
| B14 Phone | PHONE_P1 |
| B15 Signature | NEEDS-YOU |

After mdoc restores your name, write it in block capitals for B03. For B09, enter your arrival card number directly on the form if you were issued one. For B10–B12, use the lane or road, subdistrict (*khwaeng*), and district (*khet*) of your current Thai address. Sign B15 by hand.
